title: Beetroot Dip Recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 500g of beetroot, boiled or roasted with rosemary
ldInstructionsRaw: Put the almonds in a baking tray, drizzle over 1 tbs olive oil and a generous pinch of salt. Shake to coat. Put the tray in the oven and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until they are toasted
Boil/ Roast the beetroot with rosemary, individually wrapped in foil or in a large pan, until tender
Remove the outside skin from the beetroot, slice in half and blitz the beetroot with the remaining ingredients until it reaches your desired texture
